design_philosophy: Smart Clarity - Headline metric + driver breakdown + immediate action + drilldown
theme_archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Archetype 4) merged with Jewel & Luxury (Archetype 5) for Native iOS 17/18 premium feel

structure: Top Row: Metric Label (caption2, text_secondary) + Icon (Ionicons, 16px, tone_inactive)
Bottom Row: Pill Badge (Delta % vs yesterday/target) + Subtext (footnote, text_tertiary)

Pill_Badge.logic: Background color is 15% opacity of the tone color, text is 100% opacity of the tone color. e.g., tone_good_bg + tone_good_text for optimal readability

specs.logic: Color shifts to tone_warning at 80% pace, tone_danger at 100%

Funnel.structure: Vertical stacked blocks with dynamic widths

cell.opacity: Dynamic based on metric value (0.1 to 1.0)

Section_Card.header: Title3 + Action Button (e.g., 'View All' in tone_primary)

Overview_Dashboard.header: BlurView sticky top. Contains Top-Bar Dropdown (Profile Selector) and Date Range Pill
layout: 1. Grid (flexDirection: 'row', flexWrap: 'wrap'): 4 KPI Tiles (Spend, Sales, ACOS, Orders). ACOS uses tone_good if < Target, tone_danger if > Target.
2. Section_Card: Net Profit Chart. LineChart (react-native-gifted-charts) with Sparkline styling. Massive metric at top.
3. Section_Card (Row Layout): Budget Pace Ring on left, Funnel visualization on right.
4. Section_Card: Top Books by Net. List of rows. Row = Asin/Book Icon + Title + Net Profit text.

Campaigns_List.header: Sticky SearchBar + Horizontal ScrollView of Filter Pills (Active, Paused, SP, SB, SD)
Campaigns_List.item: Swipe_Row -> Left: Campaign Name (callout) + Type Pill (SP/SB/SD). Right: ACOS tone indicator dot + Spend/Sales metrics. Subtitle: Daily Budget.

layout: 1. Horizontal ScrollView: Hero KPI Tiles specific to campaign.
2. Section_Card: Performance Line Chart (Clicks vs Impressions over time).
3. Section_Card: Placement Split (Top of Search vs Rest of Search vs Product Pages) - stacked bar chart.
4. Section_Card: Ad Groups List. High density swipe rows.

Tab_Bar.style: position: 'absolute', bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0, borderTopWidth: 1, borderTopColor: 'border'

guidelines.icons: Use @expo/vector-icons 'Ionicons' for iOS SF-Symbol vibe. Outline variants for inactive/secondary, filled variants for active/primary.
guidelines.animations: Use react-native-reanimated for shared element transitions. All buttons must have an active opacity/scale effect.
guidelines.information_density: Use 'caption1' and 'footnote' aggressively for secondary metrics to keep rows tight. Rely on font-weight and color for hierarchy, not just size.
guidelines.safe_areas: Use react-native-safe-area-context heavily to prevent overlaps with notches, dynamic islands, and bottom home indicators.
guidelines.borders: Instead of heavy shadows in dark mode, use 1px borders (border color) to separate cards and rows. It provides a sharper, premium OLED look.

testing_requirements.data-testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'overview-tab-button', 'campaign-row-123', 'acos-kpi-tile'). Kebab-case, role-based.
